thread.title_full: Kiser Pannier named Conference USA Golfer of the Week after Magnolia Collegiate performance

author: Y. B. Mcgovern
title: Kiser Pannier named Conference USA Golfer of the Week after Magnolia Collegiate performance
text:
Missouri State senior Kiser Pannier was named Energy Transfer Conference USA Golfer of the Week on Mar. 18 following her showing at the Magnolia Collegiate in Mobile, Alabama.
Pannier, who is from Sedalia, Missouri, competed in challenging weather conditions during the tournament held on March 16 and 17. She tied for eighth place with scores of 78, 73, and 75 for a total of 226 over three rounds at the Magnolia Grove Crossings Course. The course is part of the Robert Trent Jones Golf Trail and measures 6,204 yards with a par of 72. Pannier ranked fourth among all players in the field by recording 36 pars across her rounds.
This recognition marks Pannier’s first weekly honor from Conference USA but is her third career weekly award overall. She had previously been named Golfer of the Week twice while competing in the Missouri Valley Conference. Currently, she holds second place on her team with a scoring average of 74.30.
The Missouri State Bears women’s golf team will return to competition from March 23 to March 25 as they host the Ozarks National Invitational in Hollister, Missouri.
